```{ojs}
// Loaded at runtime with a fresh URL so a cached older ctd.js is never mixed with this page.
ctdlib = import(new URL(`ctd.js?v=${Date.now()}`, document.baseURI).href)
parseBasket = ctdlib.parseBasket
parseDate = ctdlib.parseDate
setup = ctdlib.setup
simulate = ctdlib.simulate
optionAdjustedDV01 = ctdlib.optionAdjustedDV01
sweep = ctdlib.sweep
normals = ctdlib.normals
to32nds = ctdlib.to32nds
chartlib = import(new URL(`charts.js?v=${Date.now()}`, document.baseURI).href)
Plotly = require("plotly.js-dist-min@2.35.2")
plot = (data, layout, height) => chartlib.plot(Plotly, data, layout, height)
COLORS = chartlib.COLORS
data = FileAttachment("baskets.json").json()
MARKETS = ["UST", "Bund", "OAT", "BTP"]
// The URL hash can name a market (#BTP) or a contract (#IK).
hash = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1))
startMarket = data.contracts[hash]?.market ?? (MARKETS.includes(hash) ? hash : MARKETS[0])
```

```{ojs}
viewof market = {
  const el = html`<ul class="nav nav-tabs mb-3">${MARKETS.map((m, i) => html`<li class="nav-item">
    <a class="nav-link" href="#" data-market=${m}>${m}</a></li>`)}</ul>`;
  el.value = startMarket;
  for (const a of el.querySelectorAll("a")) {
    a.classList.toggle("active", a.dataset.market === startMarket);
    a.onclick = (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      for (const b of el.querySelectorAll("a")) b.classList.toggle("active", b === a);
      el.value = a.dataset.market;
      history.replaceState(null, "", `#${el.value}`);
      el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    };
  }
  return el;
}
```

#### Contract

```{ojs}
viewof code = Inputs.radio(
  Object.keys(data.contracts).filter(k => data.contracts[k].market === market),
  {value: data.contracts[hash]?.market === market ? hash : Object.keys(data.contracts).find(k => data.contracts[k].market === market),
   format: k => `${k} · ${data.contracts[k].name}`}
)
cfg = data.contracts[code]
```

#### Generic yield

```{ojs}
viewof drift = Inputs.range([-300, 300], {value: 0, step: 5, label: "Drift (bp / year)"})
viewof vol = Inputs.range([20, 250], {value: cfg.vol, step: 1, label: "Vol (bp / year)"})
viewof nScen = Inputs.select([2000, 5000, 10000, 20000], {value: 10000, label: "Scenarios"})
```

```{ojs}
html`<p class="small text-muted">Default vol: 65-day realised vol of the ${cfg.generic}.
Daily ≈ ${(vol / Math.sqrt(252)).toFixed(1)} bp. To delivery: mean ${(drift * model.T).toFixed(0)} bp,
s.d. ${(vol * Math.sqrt(model.T)).toFixed(0)} bp (${(model.T * 365.25).toFixed(0)} days).</p>`
```

isoDate = s => s.includes("/") ? s.split("/").reverse().join("-") : s

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-9}

```{ojs}
model = {
  const d = parseDate(delivery);
  return setup({
    basket: parseBasket(basketText),
    analysisDate: parseDate(asOf),
    deliveryDate: d,
    firstDeliveryDay: new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), d.getUTCMonth(), 1)),
    roundMonths: cfg.roundMonths ?? 3,
    freq: cfg.freq,
    cfMethod: cfg.cf === "cme" ? "cme" : "eurex",
    notional: code === "UB" ? 0.04 : 0.06
  });
}
W = normals(nScen, 1)
params = ({drift: drift / 10000, vol: vol / 10000})
run = simulate(model, W, {...params, keepScenarios: true})
names = model.bonds.map(b => b.name)
ctd = model.bonds[model.ctd0]
perPoint = cfg.face / 100
oaDV01 = optionAdjustedDV01(model, W, params) * perPoint
ctdDV01 = ctd.beta * ctd.dv01 / ctd.cf * perPoint
pSwitch = 1 - run.prob[model.ctd0]
ccy = cfg.currency
```

```{ojs}
tile = (label, value, note) => html`<div><div class="border rounded p-2 h-100">
  <div class="small text-muted">${label}</div>
  <div class="fs-5 fw-semibold">${value}</div>
  <div class="small text-muted">${note}</div></div></div>`

html`<div class="mb-3" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 0.5rem;">
  ${tile("Current CTD", ctd.name, `price / CF ${ctd.f0.toFixed(3)}`)}
  ${tile("P(CTD switch)", `${(pSwitch * 100).toFixed(1)}%`, "by delivery")}
  ${tile("Option-adj. DV01", `${ccy}${oaDV01.toFixed(1)}`, `per ${ccy}${cfg.face / 1000}k contract, per bp`)}
  ${tile("CTD DV01 / CF", `${ccy}${ctdDV01.toFixed(1)}`, `β-weighted · gap ${(oaDV01 - ctdDV01 >= 0 ? "+" : "")}${(oaDV01 - ctdDV01).toFixed(1)}`)}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
grid = sweep(model, W.slice(0, Math.max(500, Math.min(2000, Math.round(20000 / model.bonds.length)))), params, d3.range(-200, 301, 10))
// Bonds that are ever CTD, here or along the yield sweep: these get legend entries and colours.
active = names.filter((n, i) => run.prob[i] > 0 || grid.some(g => g.prob[i] > 0.01))
```

#### Distribution of outcomes at delivery, coloured by CTD

```{ojs}
{
  const dys = run.scenarios.map(d => d.dy);
  const [lo, hi] = d3.extent(dys);
  const xbins = {start: lo, end: hi, size: (hi - lo) / 80 || 1};
  return plot(active.map((n, i) => ({
    type: "histogram", name: n, x: run.scenarios.filter(d => d.ctd === n).map(d => d.dy), xbins,
    marker: {color: COLORS[i % COLORS.length], line: {width: 0}},
    hovertemplate: `${n}<br>Δy %{x} bp<br>%{y} scenarios<extra></extra>`
  })), {barmode: "stack", bargap: 0.02,
    xaxis: {title: {text: "Change in generic yield to delivery (bp)"}},
    yaxis: {title: {text: "Scenarios"}}}, 340);
}
```

using ${Math.max(500, Math.min(2000, Math.round(20000 / model.bonds.length))).toLocaleString()} scenarios. When a CTD switch is likely,
the futures DV01 departs from the current CTD's DV01 / CF, so hedge ratios based on the CTD alone over- or under-hedge.</p>`

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Methodology

1. **Scenarios.** The generic yield follows Brownian motion with drift:
   Δy<sup>g</sup> = μT + σ√T · W, W ~ N(0, 1), where T is the time to delivery.
2. **Bond yields at delivery.** Each deliverable moves with its beta: y<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> = y<sub>0</sub><sup>i</sup> + β<sup>i</sup> · Δy<sup>g</sup>.
3. **CTD.** Clean prices P<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> are computed for settlement on the delivery date; the bond with the
   lowest P<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> / CF<sup>i</sup> is the CTD in that scenario. CTD probability = share of scenarios.
4. **Net basis fair value.** In each scenario the futures price is F<sub>T</sub> = min<sub>i</sub> P<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> / CF<sup>i</sup> and the basis
   is B<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> = P<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> − F<sub>T</sub> · CF<sup>i</sup>. The fair value of the net basis is the average B<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup>
   across scenarios, since a long net basis position converges to the basis at delivery.
5. **Option-adjusted DV01.** The change in expected futures price E[F<sub>T</sub>] for a 1 bp shift in today's generic
   yield (central difference with the same random draws), scaled to one contract.

**Contracts.** UST: CME rules and conversion factors (6% notional coupon; term rounded down to whole months for TU and FV,
quarters otherwise); TU has a $200k face, the others $100k. Eurex: the published deliverable list and conversion
factors, €100k face, delivery on the 8 December 2026 delivery day. Bund and OAT pay annual coupons; UST and BTP semi-annual.

**Data.** UST yields interpolate the Treasury par curve at each maturity, so they ignore on/off-the-run and
coupon effects. Eurex yields are each bond's Borsa Italiana reference price yield. Betas come from 65 days of
daily curve changes; for OAT and BTP baskets, which have no free daily country curve, betas use the German curve
shape and vol is German vol scaled by the French or Italian / German ratio of monthly yield-change vol (FRED).

**Simplifications.** A single delivery date (the timing, end-of-month and wild-card options are ignored),
today's yields are used as the expected yields at delivery unless a drift is set, and the curve moves through one factor.
:::
